'''Hydroskiffs''' were a type of [[boat]] that were available at [[Veelo docks|docks]] on the [[planet]] [[Veelo]],<ref name="BadTerritory" /> where they could be bought, bartered, or rented from [[DUM-series pit droid|pit droids]] working at the docks.<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|hydroskiff|hydroskiff}}</ref> During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|308}}</ref> [[Fennec Shand]], [[Hunter]], and [[Wrecker]] used a hydroskiff while tracking the [[bounty hunter]] [[Sylar Saris]].<ref name="BadTerritory" />
